As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears... |requirement = |startLocation = |prev = Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled |next = Song of the Heart Sword |rewards =Union EXP*500;Astrite*50;Wind-Laced Feathers*1;Advanced Resonance Potion*3;Advanced Sealed Tube*3;Shell Credit*30,000 }} {{Intro/Quest}} ==Steps== # Wait for 2 Days # Read Huaxu Academy’s WavesLine message # Head to the Huaxu Academy # Explore deeper # Head to where it all began ==Summary== {{color|old|Disclaimer: This is a compilation of Skip summary and may not reflect the accuracy of story.}} {{Description| While waiting for the Spectrum Test Report, Suisui finds Yangyang to give her the coming-of-age gift from their mother: a conch. Once Suisui leaves, Yangyang presses the conch to her ear. As she listens to its echoes, the mysterious figure she encountered before appears once more. The figure draws Yangyang into a Sonoro Sphere that recreates the landscape of the Gorges of Spirits. There, the figure reveals that Yangyang meeting you carried an indelible significance, and her that her path as the Votary of the Voice is about to begin. When Yangyang asks about the figure's identity, it simply replies that it is merely the echo of a passing breeze before dissolving. Returning to reality, Yangyang is joined by you just as you arrive at Huaxu Academy. The results of the Spectrum Test Report catch you both off guard. The data indicates that Yangyang's source of Resonance has not changed at all—an anomaly that even the Academy's physicians can't explain. Despite the inexplicable results, Yangyang refuses to let them cast a shadow over her spirit. All she knows is that she has awakened a new strength, her wings fuller and stronger than ever before. Standing by your side, she finally gathers the courage to say the words she has held close to her heart for so long.}} ==Dialogue== {{Quest Description|After the Autopuppet crisis was resolved, the Huaxu Academy invites Yangyang to undergo another Spectrum examination. However, as Yangyang awaited the results, that mysterious voice finds its way to her once more...}} {{Dialogue Start}} ;{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact}} Read Huaxu Academy's WavesLine message {{WavesLine|text = :'''Luoqing:''' {{Rover}}, about that data you sent over... It is possible they would recognize what this is. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 30 26.ogg}} '''Luoqing:''' But for now, all your indicators are within normal range. The changes won't hinder your daily life or combat effectiveness. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 30 27.ogg}} '''Luoqing:''' Take these reports. You may report to the Ministry of War. After all, we have more urgent problems to solve in Xuanfang Hold first. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 29.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Besides... you have your own fair share of mysteries too, don't you, {{Rover}}? :{{DIcon}} That is true... :{{DIcon}} It seems we share the same kind of trouble. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 32.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' This power... Though I still don't fully understand what it is... :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 33.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Now that I have it, I feel... like I can protect more people than I ever could before. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 34.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Perhaps, one day, I'll be able to... :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 36.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' No. I don't want this to be a "one day" wish. So I'll say it now. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 37.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' {{Rover}}, I want to stand beside you. Sorrow or smile, stillness or storm... Whatever comes, I want to face it standing beside you. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 38.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' If you're the wind that wanders, then let me be the bird that sails upon it. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 39.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' My wings might not be strong enough yet. Maybe there's still a long way for me to go before I can truly keep up with you. :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 40.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' But this vow will never change. This feeling will be the beacon that guides me— :{{A|Vo main huanglong llzqmxy 31 41.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' —Until the end of the world. :
